_comment: Single-run Record + Detect configuration for BrightSign Extension Demo
_comment2: This config enables AUTO mode: builds reference from tv1 while detecting anomalies on both monitors

reference._comment_mode: AUTO mode: builds reference online from tv1 while simultaneously detecting anomalies
reference._comment_ref_fps: Should match anomaly.sample_fps for clean timeline advancement
reference._comment_search: Matcher searches ±4s around predicted position for resync
reference._comment_auto_source: tv_id = use specific monitor as reference (best for demos), consensus = medoid across all (best for 5-6 TVs)
reference._comment_ref_tv_id: Which monitor provides the reference timeline (tv1 = left monitor with clean video)
reference._comment_warmup: Wait 3 seconds before enabling FREEZE/LAG/MISMATCH detection (BLACK works immediately)
reference._comment_max: Keep max 10 minutes of reference in memory (ring buffer)
reference._comment_persist: Optionally save the generated reference to file for debugging/replay

roi._comment: IMPORTANT: Adjust x,y,w,h coordinates to match your camera framing!

tvs._comment: Left monitor - REFERENCE (clean video) - provides the reference timeline
Right monitor - TEST (video with freeze/black) - compared against tv1

anomaly._comment_sample: Must match reference.ref_fps for proper timeline sync
anomaly._comment_freeze_detail: Detects when tv2 timeline stops advancing while tv1 continues
anomaly._comment_mismatch_detail: Detects when tv2 content differs significantly from reference
anomaly._comment_lag_detail: Detects when tv2 is more than 1.5s behind the reference timeline

mqtt._comment: Events tagged with tv_id (tv1 or tv2) to identify which monitor has the anomaly
